name: Biological Sciences PhD
detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed.
summary: Research doctorate at the University of Alaska Fairbanks; collaborative study with University of Alaska Anchorage faculty is available.

applicationFee.note: Central Graduate School advertises limited-time free PhD applications using code #UAFR1. Expiry and international eligibility are not stated; confirm the offer remains applicable before payment.

english.note: PTE55 also accepted. Central international admissions lists exempt countries; exception requests may be emailed to Admissions. No general English-medium degree exemption stated in this source.

documents: Statement of academic and professional goals
Official transcripts from all postsecondary institutions
International course-by-course evaluation from TEC or WES (Canadian institutions outside Quebec exempt)
requirements.note: Central minimum bachelor’s degree with cumulative and major GPA3.0. In-progress unofficial records may be used for review, final official records required after admission. Department requires strong relevant preparation, an agreed Biology and Wildlife major advisor, and a funding plan before admission. No specific course prerequisites. UAA co-advisor collaboration possible; at least one advisor must be UAF Biology and Wildlife.

publishedDeadlines.label: Fall complete application
publishedDeadlines.note: No year stated; confirm the intended admission cycle.

publishedDeadlines.note: No year stated; confirm the intended admission cycle.

funding.note: Department identifies a funding plan for the student and research before admission. Central page describes departmental assistantships with tuition waivers, but no universal stipend/benefits package established.

timeline.decisions: Approximately six weeks after application deadlines.
